name: Setsujuu ~Yuganda Kioku~
source:
A guy went on a graduation ski trip with his friend and their girlfriends. Before and during the trip, he met and had fun with a bunch of females. In some places, you can choose which girl he have fun with by going to one place or another.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160402092638/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-m.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
一个男孩和朋友及各自的女友一起参加毕业滑雪旅行。在旅行前和旅途中，他结识了许多女性并与她们玩乐。在某些地点，玩家可以前往不同地方，选择让他和哪名女孩一起玩。

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160402092638/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-m.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
